Settings.Ignore.HiddenEntries.Descriptio: Name or mask ("Thumbs.db", "*.tmp") or full path ("C:\pagefile.sys").
Settings.Ignore.KeepTheListInThis: Keep the list in this file
Settings.Ignore.KeepTheListInThis.Descri: One entry per line (# starts a comment); written with Apply / OK. Empty = in the settings.
Settings.Index.Excluded.Description: Separated by ;: folder names (node_modules) or full paths (C:\Windows\WinSxS). The trash and system folders are always left out.
Settings.Index.Off: Off (starts when the settings are applied)
Settings.Index.Roots.DescriptionUnix: Separated by ;. Empty: the home folder.
Settings.Index.Roots.DescriptionWindows: Separated by ;. Empty: all fixed drives.
Settings.Index.UseOwnIndex: Use the application's own file index
Settings.Index.UseOwnIndex.Description: The names, sizes and times of the files and folders on the chosen disks are indexed in the background; find files, duplicate files and folder sizes answer at once. No Everything, plocate or Spotlight needed. The first scan can take a few minutes; later only changed folders are read, and changes are followed live while running.
Settings.Layout.ButtonBarButtons.Descrip: Add, remove, move and change buttons (command, parameters, icon, tooltip) in the button bar editor.
Settings.Layout.ButtonBarIconSize.Descri: To edit the buttons one by one: Configuration > Button bar...
Settings.Layout.ShortcutDesktop.Descript: The Desktop folder at the end of the drive buttons.
Settings.Layout.ShortcutDocuments.Descri: The Documents folder at the end of the drive buttons.
Settings.Layout.ShortcutDownloads.Descri: The Downloads folder at the end of the drive buttons.
Settings.Layout.ShortcutHome.Description: The user's home folder at the end of the drive buttons.
Settings.Log.KeepOldLogFiles.Description: The oldest ones beyond this number are deleted.
Settings.Log.LogFile.Description: Empty: operations.log in the logs folder of the settings. Environment variables can be used (%USERPROFILE%).
Settings.Log.ServerOperations.Descriptio: Transfers to and from servers, deleting on servers.
Settings.Log.SkippedFiles.Description: When "Skip" was chosen for an existing file.
Settings.Log.StartANewLogFile.Descriptio: The old file keeps its date in the name (e.g. log-20261110.txt).
Settings.Log.Unpacking.Description: Copying out of archives (Alt+F9, or F5 inside an archive).
Settings.Log.WhenLarger: When it is larger than the size below
Settings.Misc.DeletingFoldersThatAreNot: Deleting folders that are not empty
Asked also when deleting is not confirmed otherwise.
Settings.Misc.FilesCanBeDroppedOn: Files can be dropped on the F8 Delete button
Settings.Misc.RealTerminal.Description: The shell runs on a pseudo terminal (ConPTY on Windows, a pty on Linux and macOS): colors, cursor movement and full screen programs such as vim, mc and top work. When off, a simple line console is used. Applies to newly opened tabs.
Settings.Misc.Shell.Description: Shell of the terminal opened with the terminal button at the end of the command line (e.g. pwsh, powershell, /bin/zsh). Empty: cmd.exe on Windows, $SHELL elsewhere. Applies to a newly started shell.
Settings.Misc.SoundWhenAnOperationEnds.D: A sound file (.wav; .mp3 too on Linux and macOS) played when copying, deleting, packing ... is over.
Settings.Misc.StartMenu.Description: The items of the Start menu: a program (with parameters and start folder) or a nc_ command; separators group them.
Settings.Operation.AlwaysGoToTheRoot: Always go to the root when changing drives
Settings.Operation.AlwaysGoToTheRoot.Des: When off, goes back to the folder last used on that drive.
Settings.Operation.AppendSuggestedName.D: The first suggestion is added, selected, after what was typed; typing on replaces it.
Settings.Operation.AutoCompletePaths.Des: In the path bar, the copy / move target and the command line, folders matching the typed path are listed (Tab, or Enter after choosing with ↑ / ↓, takes a suggestion; Enter alone goes to what is typed).
Settings.Operation.CalculateTheFolderSiz: Calculate the folder size when selecting with Space
Settings.Operation.CheckForUpdatesAtStar: At most once a day; notifies only if a new version is available.
Settings.Operation.CopyMoveCommentsWithT: Copy / move comments with the files
In local folders; also when renaming.
Settings.Operation.FoldersAndTabs.Descri: When off, the folders last saved with "Save settings" open.
Settings.Operation.FolderSizeFromEveryth: Use the file index for folder sizes
Folder sizes come at once from the application's own file index (when on) or from Everything (Windows, es.exe); without either the folder is walked.
Settings.Operation.MoveToTheSystemTray: Move to the system tray when minimized
Settings.Operation.MoveToTheSystemTray.D: The window leaves the taskbar; clicking the tray icon brings it back.
Settings.Operation.SelectionWithNum.Desc: Num+ / Num- patterns, Num* (invert selection) and Select all. A pattern ending in \ (name\) selects folders either way.
Files and folders open with one click (Ctrl / Shift click selects).
Settings.Operation.RowsKeptVisibleBelowA: Rows kept visible below and above the cursor
While scrolling; 0 = off. In the full view.
Settings.Operation.SelectByClickingTheIc: A left click on a file's icon selects it (full and brief view).
Settings.Operation.SelectionModeTouchOnl: Selection mode only on touch screens
Tapping selects, holding opens the context menu; the mouse works as usual.
Settings.Operation.SelectOnlyTheNameWhen: Select only the name when renaming
Settings.Operation.SelectWithTheRightBut: Select with the right button (Norton Commander style)
Right-clicking marks the file; held (0.6 s) it opens the context menu. On macOS a right click with the mouse (two fingers, Ctrl+click) always opens the menu, marking is Cmd+click.
Settings.Operation.ShowProgressInTheTitl: Percentage in the window title during long operations.
Settings.Operation.SingleInstance.Descri: A second launch sends the folder/file to the running window.
Settings.Operation.SystemContextMenu: Show the system's context menu (Windows Explorer)
Settings.Operation.SystemContextMenu.Des: The menu of the files as in Explorer (open with, send to, share, the entries of installed programs). Shift+right click opens NextCommander's own menu.
Settings.Operation.UpdateURL.Description: URL of a JSON file with version info ({"version","url"}) or a GitHub releases/latest API URL. When empty, updates are never checked.
Settings.Packer.DefaultArchiveFormat.Des: Format preselected in the Alt+F5 dialog.
Settings.Packer.EnterOpensArchives.Descr: When off, archives open with the system application (Ctrl+PgDn always enters).
Settings.Packer.SetTheArchiveDateTo: Set the archive date to the date of its newest file
Settings.Packer.SetTheArchiveDateTo.Desc: Applies to archives packed to a local disk.
Settings.Refresh.DoNotRememberTheseDrive: Drive letters or folders separated by ; (e.g. E;F): tabs there open the home folder the next time.
Settings.Refresh.NoAutomaticRefreshInThe: No automatic refresh in these folders
Settings.Refresh.NotWhileTheProgramIs: Not while the program is in the background
Settings.Refresh.NotWhileTheProgramIs.De: Changes made while another program has the focus are shown when NextCommander gets it back.
Settings.Refresh.PutFilesThatAppearAt: Put files that appear at the end of the list
Settings.Refresh.PutFilesThatAppearAt.De: Until the list is sorted or refreshed again (Ctrl+R).
Settings.Refresh.RefreshFileListsAutomat: The list updates itself when the shown folder changes.
Settings.Refresh.RefreshThePanelsWhenThe: Refresh the panels when the main window gets the focus
Useful when automatic refresh is off.
Settings.SevenZip.AlsoEncryptTheFileName: With a password the names in the archive can only be listed after entering it.
Settings.SevenZip.CreateSolidArchives.De: Better compression; reading or changing a single file of the archive is slower.
Settings.SevenZip.DictionarySize.Descrip: Larger: better compression of big archives, more memory.
Settings.SevenZip.ExtraParameters.Descri: Added to the 7-Zip command line when packing (e.g. -mqs=on -mtc=on).
Settings.SevenZip.WordSize.Description: Larger: a little better compression, slower.
Settings.SevenZip.ZipPath.Description: 7z archives are written with this program; when empty, PATH and the usual install folders are searched.
Settings.Tabs.AllTabsHaveTheSame: All tabs have the same width
Settings.Tabs.ClickingATabActivatesIts: Clicking a tab activates its panel
Settings.Tabs.ClickingATabActivatesIts.D: When off, clicking a tab of the other panel only switches the tab.
Settings.Tabs.CtrlTabShowsTheList: Ctrl+Tab shows the list of tabs
Settings.Tabs.CtrlTabShowsTheList.Descri: While Ctrl is held, Tab moves through the list; releasing Ctrl switches to the selected tab.
Settings.Tabs.CtrlTabSwitchesToThe: Ctrl+Tab switches to the most recently used tab
Settings.Tabs.CtrlTabSwitchesToThe.Descr: When off, switches to the tab on the right.
Settings.Tabs.CtrlUpOpensTheNew: Ctrl+Up opens the new tab in the foreground
Settings.Tabs.CtrlUpOpensTheNew.Descript: When off, the new tab opens in the background.
Settings.Tabs.OpenNewTabsNextTo: Open new tabs next to the current tab
Settings.Tabs.OpenNewTabsNextTo.Descript: When off, they are added at the end.
Settings.Tabs.SaveTheFileTypeFilter: Save the file type filter of each tab
Settings.Tabs.ShowIconsOnTabs.Descriptio: Folder icon; a lock on locked tabs. System folders (documents, downloads, desktop, home) always show their own icon.
Settings.Tabs.ShowTabHeaderAlsoWhen: Show tab header also when there is only one tab
Settings.Tabs.ShowTheDriveLetterIn: Show the drive letter in the tab title
Settings.Tabs.TabsOnSeveralRows.Descript: Tabs that do not fit go to the next row instead of scrolling.
Settings.Thumbs.ClearTheCache.Descriptio: Deletes the thumbnails kept on disk; they are made again when shown.
Settings.Thumbs.Fields.Description: Column fields shown under every thumbnail, separated by spaces (e.g. image.dimensions media.duration).
Settings.Thumbs.ImageViewerProgram.Descr: IrfanView (i_view64.exe) or XnView nconvert converts these files to a thumbnail.
Settings.Thumbs.KeepThumbnailsOnDisk.Des: Thumbnails are stored in the settings folder ("thumbs") and appear at once the next time. Takes effect after a restart.
Settings.Thumbs.ThumbnailsFromExplorerFo: Explorer's thumbnail handlers (videos, PDF, Office files ...), e.g. *.mp4 *.pdf or *.*; empty = off.
Settings.Thumbs.FieldsByType.Description: Files matching a mask show these fields instead; the first matching mask wins.
Settings.ViewModes.ViewModes.Description: Column sets: their columns, the folders that switch to them automatically, background and tab colors, commands run on entering and leaving.
Settings.Zip.DefaultCompressionLevel.Des: Level selected first in the Alt+F5 dialog (zip, 7z, tar.gz ...).
Settings.Zip.Encryption.Description: ZipCrypto is weak but Windows Explorer and old programs can open it; AES needs a program such as 7-Zip or WinRAR.
Settings.Zip.FolderForTemporaryFiles.Des: Used while packing to a server and while changing archives (empty = the system's temp folder).
Settings.Zip.KeepDamagedFilesBadCRC.Desc: A file unpacked from a damaged archive is kept instead of deleted; the error is still shown.
Settings.Zip.OpenPartialZipFiles.Descrip: A zip without its end (an unfinished download, one part of a split archive) is listed from the headers of its files; it can only be read.
Settings.Zip.UseShortNames.Description: Names such as LONGNA~1.TXT, for very old unpackers (where the disk keeps short names).
Settings.Zip.Utf8Names.Description: When off, names are written in the system's OEM code page (for old programs that do not know UTF-8).
Settings.Assoc.InternalAssociationsEnter: Enter opens these file types with the command given: a program (with parameters), a nc_ command, Lister, the editor or the system's program. Shift+Enter: open together.
Settings.Plugins.InstalledPlugins.Descri: Unchecked plugins are not loaded. Takes effect after a restart.
Settings.Plugins.NoPlugins: No plugins are installed. A plugin is a folder with a plugin.json in the plugins folder of the settings folder or of the program.
Settings.Proxy.AlsoForLocalNames: Also for local names (without a dot)
Settings.Proxy.OnlyWhenTheProxyAsks: only when the proxy asks for one
Settings.Proxy.KeptEncrypted: kept encrypted in the password store
Settings.Proxy.TypeAnAddress: Type an http or https address to try.
Settings.Proxy.AsksForAUser: The proxy asks for a user name and password (407).
Settings.Proxy.Connections.Description: WebDAV, S3, Azure Blob, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, URL downloads and the update check go this way; FTP, SFTP and SMB too with a proxy of your own (when chosen below). Open connections keep their way until they connect again.
Settings.Proxy.AlsoForFileTransfers: Also for FTP, SFTP and SMB connections
Settings.Proxy.AlsoForFileTransfersTip: An HTTP proxy has to allow CONNECT to their ports (21, 22, 445 ...); a SOCKS5 proxy takes any connection.
SettingsTransfer.TheFileIsNotA: The file is not a NextCommander settings export.
SettingsTransfer.TheSettingsInTheFileAre: The settings in the file are empty.
SettingsTransfer.TheSettingsInTheFileCan: The settings in the file cannot be read: {0}
SettingsTransfer.ThereAreNoSettingsTo: There are no settings to export yet.
SettingsWindow.AboutN0MBToPack: about {0:N0} MB to pack, {1:N0} MB to unpack
SettingsWindow.AddsTheFilesAndFolders: Adds the files and folders selected in the active panel.
SettingsWindow.AddThemWithTheirFull: Add them with their full path
SettingsWindow.AnEstimateForLZMALZMA2: An estimate for LZMA / LZMA2 (7-Zip's own numbers can differ a little).
SettingsWindow.CommandCmCommandProgramPa: Command (nc_ command, program path), Parameters, Icon, Tooltip; Command "-" is a separator.
SettingsWindow.CommandLineOnlyWhenIt: Command line only when it has the focus
SettingsWindow.DoNotLoadEXELNK: Do not load EXE/LNK icons on removable disks
SettingsWindow.DriveBoxFreeSpaceAnd: Drive box, free space, \ and .. buttons.
SettingsWindow.DriveButtonBarAboveEach: Drive button bar above each panel.
SettingsWindow.HelpChangedBar: A bar at the left of a setting shows that it differs from the default; Reset page sets the whole page back to the defaults.
SettingsWindow.HelpChoosePage: Choose a page on the left or type the name of a setting into the search box (Ctrl+F; e.g. "recycle", "theme"). A search result's title opens its page.
SettingsWindow.HoveringOverAPathSeparato: Hovering over a path separator opens the subfolder list.
SettingsWindow.Json.AssociationCommandEm: Command is empty (a program path, a nc_ command, "lister", "editor" or "system")
SettingsWindow.Json.ButtonCommandEmpty: Command is empty (a nc_ command, a program path, or "-" for a separator)
SettingsWindow.Json.DarkColorInvalid: DarkColor is not a valid color: "{0}" (#RRGGBB)
SettingsWindow.Json.LightColorInvalid: LightColor is not a valid color: "{0}" (#RRGGBB)
SettingsWindow.Json.SyntaxError: JSON syntax error (missing comma, quote or bracket)
SettingsWindow.Json.WrongType: wrong type of value (e.g. text instead of a number)
SettingsWindow.NaturalAlphabeticalNumber: Natural: alphabetical, numbers by value (file2 < file10)
SettingsWindow.NoSettingsOnThisPage: No settings on this page; see its subpages.
SettingsWindow.ResetPage.Tip: Sets every setting of this page back to its default (until Apply / OK nothing is written).
SettingsWindow.ShortcutsHotlistColumnSet: Shortcuts, hotlist, column sets and connections are edited with the buttons on the Misc. page.
SettingsWindow.ShowButtonsForHistoryList: Show buttons for history list and hotlist
SettingsWindow.TheBarBetweenThePanels: The bar between the panels; same format as above.
SettingsWindow.ThePathLineAboveThe: The path line above the file list.
SettingsWindow.TwoDriveButtonBarsAbove: Two drive button bars (above the file windows)
SettingsWindow.TypingInThePanelGoes: Typing in the panel goes to the command line, the focus stays in the panel; Enter opens the file under the cursor.
SettingsWindow.WhenOffDriveButtonsHave: When off, drive buttons have a frame.
SettingsWindow.WhenOffOneBarFor: When off, one bar for the active panel below the button bar.
SettingsWindow.WhenOffThePathIs: When off, the path is shown as plain text.
SettingsWindow.AListHasAnError: A list has an error (shown in red): correct it or leave with Cancel.
SettingsWindow.EmptyTheFolderOfThe: empty = the folder of the panel
SettingsWindow.Label: Label
SettingsWindow.NameInTheOpenWith: name in the Open with menu
SevenZipCli.ZipNotFound7zz7z: 7-Zip not found (7zz / 7z). Install it or specify its path with the FM_7Z environment variable.
SevenZipCli.ZipSomeFilesCouldNot: 7-Zip: some files could not be added.
SftpFileSystemProvider.TheKeyFileRequire: The key file requires a passphrase.
SmbFileSystemProvider.FilesGoIntoAShare: SMB: files are written into a share.
SmbFileSystemProvider.MoveBetweenShares: Moving between shares is done by copying.
SmbFileSystemProvider.SharesAreDeletedOn: SMB: shares are deleted on the server.
SmbFileSystemProvider.SMBCouldNotConnect: SMB: could not connect to {0}:{1} through the proxy.
SplitCombine.SelectTheFirstPartWith: Select the first part with the .001 extension to combine.
SplitCombine.SizeMismatchExpectedCombine: Size mismatch: expected {0}, combined {1} bytes (missing part?).
SyncDirsWindow.FilesIdenticalDifferentLe: {0} files: {1} identical, {2} different, {3} left only, {4} right only. {5} operations selected.
SyncDirsWindow.ItemsWillBeCopiedTo: {0} items will be copied to the right, {1} items to the left
TerminalView.ChooseShell: New terminal with a chosen shell
TerminalView.PanelFolder.Tooltip: Go to the folder of the active panel in the terminal
TerminalView.Stop.Tooltip: Stop the running program and restart the shell (Ctrl+C)
TerminalView.Title: TERMINAL
ToolDialogs.AlsoApplyToEverythingIn: Also apply to everything in subfolders
UpdateChecker.CouldNotReachTheUpdate: Could not reach the update URL:
UpdateChecker.UpdateURLDidNotRespond: Update URL did not respond: HTTP {0}
WebProxyConfig.ThePortMustBeBetween: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
WebProxyConfig.TheProxyServerIsNotValid: The proxy server is not a valid name or address.
WindowsPlatformService.SharesDenied: {0}: no permission to see the shares.
Settings.Color.EditColors.Description: Change the colors of a theme with color pickers, or start a new theme from the colors in effect. A shipped theme is saved as your own copy.
Settings.Icons.EditIcons.Description: Change the style, the corner marks and the colors of an icon pack, or make a new pack from the chosen one. A shipped pack is saved as your own copy.
Settings.Language.Translate.Description: Translate the texts of the program into a new language, or improve a translation; saved into the languages folder of the settings and used after a restart.
ThemeEditorDialog.Hint: An area left at "default" takes its color from the light or dark look (or from a related area).
ThemeEditorDialog.LeaveThisAreaToThe: Leave this area to the light or dark look
IconPackEditorDialog.TheIconColorOfThe: The icon color of the color theme
IconPackEditorDialog.SmallMarksAtTheCorn: Small marks at the corner of menu icons (plus, cross, arrow)
IconPackEditorDialog.ColorsOfTheMenuAnd: Colors of the menu and button bar icons
IconPackEditorDialog.ColorsOfTheFileType: Colors of the file type icons
IconPackEditorDialog.GiveTheIconPackA: Give the icon pack a name.
IconPackEditorDialog.ThePackKeepsTheIcon: The pack keeps the {0} icon shapes of the pack it was made from.
LanguageEditorDialog.NameInTheLanguageE: Name in the language, e.g. Italiano
LanguageEditorDialog.KeepTheyStandForNam: Keep {0}, {1} ... (they stand for names and numbers), key names such as Ctrl and the underscore of menu access keys (_File). Untranslated texts stay in English. Used after a restart.
LanguageEditorDialog.GiveTheLanguageCode: Give the language code of two or three small letters (it, pt, pt-BR ...); en is the original.
LanguageEditorDialog.GiveTheNameOfThe: Give the name of the language in that language.
LanguageEditorDialog.TheTranslationOfLac: The translation of "{0}" lacks a placeholder of the English text.
Settings.Index.UseChangeJournal: Use the NTFS change journal at start
Settings.Index.UseChangeJournal.Descript: The disk keeps a list of every change; at start only the folders named there are read again, including files whose contents changed while the program was closed. Needs no administrator rights. Where the list cannot tell (other file systems, too many changes), the folder times are compared.
Settings.Index.FullCheckHours.Descriptio: Reads all folders again after this many hours (at start or while running), also those whose time did not change, so that sizes and times of files changed while the program was closed are corrected. Takes as long as the first scan. 0 = never.
Settings.Log.WriteALogOfFileOperations: Write a log of file operations
Settings.Log.WriteALogOfFileOperations.D: Copying, moving, deleting, packing ... are appended to a text file (what is written: below).
Settings.Log.WriteTheProgramLog.Descript: Errors and events of NextCommander itself, for finding problems: nextcommander-<date>.log in the logs folder of the settings, one file a day, the last 7 days kept.
CommandPickerDialog.ChooseACommandFromTh: Choose a command from the list
QuickListDialog.GiveANameAndA: Give a name and a folder or command.
QuickListDialog.HotlistHint: A '/' in the name creates a submenu (e.g. Projects/WMS). An entry can run a command instead of opening a folder.
FindFilesWindow.GoToTheFileIn: Go to the file in the panel
FindFilesWindow.ShowInTheSystemFile: Show in the system file manager
FindFilesWindow.SaveTheResultsAsA: Save the results as a list of paths or as a table (CSV)
CopyDialog.AlwaysOpenTheCopyDialog: Always open the copy dialog with these options
CopyDialog.CopyNTFSPermissionsMayNeed: Copy NTFS permissions (may need administrator rights)
CopyDialog.CopyToAllSelectedFolders: Copy to all selected folders/links in the target panel
CopyDialog.FoldersAreSelectedInThe: {0} folders are selected in the target panel
CopyDialog.RenameOlderTargetFilesSkip: Rename older target files, skip newer
CopyDialog.SkipAllWhichCannotBe: Skip all which cannot be opened for reading
CopyQueueWindow.QueueTheFilesSelectedIn: Queue the files selected in the active panel (copied to the other panel)
CopyQueueWindow.TakeTheSelectedItemOut: Take the selected item out of the queue
CopyDialog.TheTargetListAndThe: The target list and the directory hotlist (F7, Ctrl+D)
CopyDialog.FindFilesSearchAndCopy: Find files: search, and copy the files found (F8)
FindFilesWindow.CloseFindFilesAndCopy: Close Find files and copy the files found to the target of the copy dialog
FindFilesWindow.NothingFoundToCopy: Nothing found to copy: search first.
AboutDialog.DualPaneFileManagerFor: Dual-pane file manager for Windows, Linux and macOS
AboutDialog.OpenTheFolderInThe: Open the folder in the panel
MainWindow.SetTheButtonBarBack: Set the button bar back to its default buttons? The buttons you added or changed are removed.
Command.nc_ResetButtonBar: Reset button bar to the default buttons
Command.nc_ResetVertButtonBar: Reset vertical button bar to the default buttons
AboutDialog.OpenTheProjectPageIn: Open the project page in the browser
TerminalView.MaximizeTheTerminalDoubleCl: Maximize the terminal (double click on the title)
TerminalView.RestoreTheTerminalSizeDoubl: Restore the terminal size (double click on the title)
